Fix: in flush_table(), set t.autofit=False, t.allow_autofit=False; calculate available content width (page_w - margins); set table width to 80% of that (leaving 10% white space on each side); set each column width explicitly to (80% / n_cols). Fix: in flush_table(), set <w:tblW> directly via XML manipulation: tblW.set('w:type', 'dxa'); tblW.set('w:w', str(table_w_dxa)). Also set <w:tblLayout type=fixed> and update each <w:gridCol w=...> in the <w:tblGrid>. Set each cell's <w:tcW> directly. Verified: all 12 table

v1.5.5: Real fix for Word mobile table centering. The previous v1.5.4 set <w:jc w:val=center> and explicit <w:tblW>, but Word mobile ignores <w:jc> for tables. New approach: add <w:tblInd w:type=dxa w:w=1513> in <w:tblPr>. tblInd is an explicit left-indent for the table. The value 1513 dxa = 2.67cm = half of (26.7cm content - 21.36cm table). This FORCES the table to start 2.67cm from the left edge of the content area, leaving 2.67cm of white space on the right — geometrically identical to center

2.0.5 增强经费预算、信息化项目、采购和整改材料的写作支持。  - 经费预算：写清费用用途和构成，区分项目总额、年度或分期安排与本次申请金额，核对计价及合计口径。 - 信息化建设：衔接已有系统与本次改造、运维范围，交代数据迁移、一次性建设和持续服务费用。 - 采购材料：更清楚地说明报价包含的内容，将核心需求、已计费服务与验收要求对应。 - 整改材料：分清问题、整改事项和责任单位，保留完成整改、阶段达标、持续推进等状态，并支持有依据的后续建议。
本次更新完善了三类常见办文场景：  - 材料报送与征集：多项材料、不同统计期间和分层报送的任务，进一步明确谁填报、统计谁、谁汇总，以及各项材料的期限和渠道。 - 代表建议、委员提案答复：更明确地选择函的写法，让答复对象、称谓与用途对应，减少无关文种参考的干扰。 - 采购更正公告：更清楚地交代原公告、更正理由和当前处理安排，区分原公告内容与后续履约、整改或解约情况。

本次更新完善申请类高频场景的分层路由：  - 请假申请：在申请主叶上叠加独立的请假附加规则，保留假别、事由、时间、交接和审批状态。 - 采购核对：将采购需求、规格报价、履约条件和采购状态集中到采购专项页，减少申请主叶混入业务细节。 - 经费预算：集中核对费用单位、阶段、计算条件、申请额度及资金落实状态，避免补造未知总额和财务规则。  本版本继续使用普通 MIT Skill，不包含 Hook、维护代码或 Pro 专属实现。

to_changelog: - Monitor writes its PID to monitor.pid at startup and installs trap ':' USR1. The no-op handler is the key trick — bash interrupts sleep whenever a trapped signal arrives, so the monitor wakes from its polling   sleep and immediately re-runs the loop iteration, sees done, and exits cleanly through the EXIT trap.   - Wrapper sends kill -USR1 <monitor_pid> right after touch done. Best-effort: if monitor.pid doesn't exist or the signal fails, the monitor still catches completion on its next schedu

1. wrapper: touch done → kill -TERM $monitor_pid   2. monitor: TERM trap fires immediately (trap is installed before monitor.pid exists, so no race)   3. handle_term function: checks done file → exists → logs "Completion signal received" → exit 0   4. EXIT trap (cleanup): updates manifest if needed, kills tmux session, removes monitor.pid   5. Monitor process is gone within milliseconds of wrapper finishing
